title.narrative: Supporting essential Health facilities and services to population impacted by the hostilities in Sarmin PHC.

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtThrough this project SAMS aims to enhance access to critical life-saving and life-sustaining comprehensive primary healthcare services to the vulnerable IDPs and Host Communities in Idleb Governorates (Sarmin sub-district), through supporting the provision of comprehensive primary healthcare services (including BEmONC) in Sarmin PHC and targeting the following communities Sarmin, Nayrab, Qminas, Saraqab, Bennsh, and Afs) with a total target population 41,612, through supporting the provision of comprehensive primary healthcare services in Sarmin PHC (HeRAMS code: G0700014! Sarmin CPHC)ltbrgtSarmin PHC is a comprehensive PHC center providing primary healthcare including BEmONC, communicable (CDs), non-communicable diseases, Vaccination, and community health services, and also provides laboratory tests, and dentistry services, in addition to CMAM services which are provided through the nutritionist located within the facility and the community health workers through their outreach activities.ltbrgtAside from the provision of technical capacity-building support, in the form of training, mentorship, and supervision, SAMS will support health infrastructure in NWS through the provision of salaries for medical and non-medical staff, running costs for facilities, consumables, medications, replacement of worn medical and non-medical equipment, besides, minor maintenance.ltbrgtit is worth mentioning that through the recent military escalation, On the 12th of October 2023, the town of Sarmin was severely bombed and one of the shells fell near the Sarmin PHC, 150 meters near the center, this resulted in damage to the center's windows, and doors due to the pressure of the explosion, therefore, there was a suspension of work for some days to ensure the safety of both beneficiaries and staff.ltbrgtby the end of the project which will extend over a period of six months, SAMS will reach a total of 27,917 beneficiaries (4,745 men, 12,264, Women, 4,994, girls, and 5,914 boys).ltbrgtlt/pgt
